precedence: Overrides only the previously underspecified EB inner-OOF score replay and outer-VALID state update procedure. Residual/key authority remains Amendment 004; history DB path remains Amendment 005. All other freezes remain unchanged.

observations.residual: e_i = z_i - fhat_i, with fhat_i the raw selected Primary GBDT prediction
observations.group_count_n_g: integer count of contributing residual observations in group g
observations.eb_observation_weighting: UNWEIGHTED arithmetic observation means/counts for EB; do not use 1/n_r as EB group weight
observations.note: The frozen 1/n_r weight remains the GBDT target/sample-weight contract; it is not the EB group-statistic weight.

horse_x_venue.contributing_rows: rows whose horse_key parent is observed in at least 2 distinct venue_key values within the dataset D used to build the state

jockey_x_venue.contributing_rows: rows with nonmissing jockey_key whose jockey parent is observed in at least 2 distinct venue_key values within dataset D

single_layer_update.adjusted_residual: For layer L, r_i^(-L) = e_i - sum_{K != L} a_K(key_K(i)). Use Gauss-Seidel values: layers already updated in the current cycle use new values; layers not yet updated use previous-cycle values.
single_layer_update.sigma2_reestimate_mode: sigma2_L = mean((r_i^(-L))^2) over L-contributing rows, ddof=0
single_layer_update.m_g: arithmetic mean of r_i^(-L) within group g
single_layer_update.n_g: integer number of L-contributing observations in group g
single_layer_update.raw_effect: if tau2_L == 0 then 0 else a_raw_g = tau2_L/(tau2_L + sigma2_L/n_g) * m_g
single_layer_update.fixed_component_mode: Do not recompute sigma2_L or tau2_L. Use the frozen outer-TRAIN pair for layer L, but recompute m_g and n_g from the current cumulative dataset D.

interaction_centering.when: immediately after raw effects for that interaction layer are computed, before moving to the next layer
interaction_centering.formula: For each identifiable parent p: c_p = sum_g(n_g*a_raw_g)/sum_g(n_g), over venue groups g under p; set a_g = a_raw_g - c_p.
interaction_centering.less_than_two_venues: all interaction effects under that parent are exactly 0

backfit.initial_effects: all effect maps exactly 0 at the start of every reference backfit call
backfit.convergence: After each full 4-layer cycle, compute max absolute effect change over the union of all keys from previous/current cycle, treating absent keys as 0. Stop if < 1e-5.
backfit.if_not_converged_by_cycle_20: Use cycle-20 effects deterministically and record converged=false plus final max change as a warning; do not tune iterations or thresholds.

inner_oof_eb_score_for_pl.selected_candidate: For each outer fold, first select one Primary candidate M1-M4 under the already-frozen selection rule. Then construct that candidate's strict inner-OOF raw predictions/residuals.
inner_oof_eb_score_for_pl.chronology: Process unique race_date values ascending across eligible inner-OOF rows, starting in 2021. All races on the same date are simultaneous.
inner_oof_eb_score_for_pl.state_dataset_for_date_d: D_<d = selected-candidate inner-OOF residual rows with race_date < d only
inner_oof_eb_score_for_pl.components_for_date_d: Run reference backfit on D_<d in REESTIMATE mode. sigma2/tau2 are estimated only from D_<d. Future dates and date-d residuals are prohibited.
inner_oof_eb_score_for_pl.score_formula: S_i^OOF = fhat_i^OOF + a_horse + a_jockey + a_horse_x_venue + a_jockey_x_venue, using the state built from D_<d
inner_oof_eb_score_for_pl.after_date_d: Only after all date-d races have been scored, their historical targets may be used to form e=z-fhat and become available to dates > d.
inner_oof_eb_score_for_pl.pl_fit_input: PL M0/M1 fitting must use these date-causal S_i^OOF scores; full-period backfit scores are prohibited.

outer_train_freeze.D_train: all selected-candidate strict inner-OOF residual rows available in the outer-TRAIN period (2021..train end)
outer_train_freeze.component_estimation: Run reference backfit on D_train in REESTIMATE mode from zero. For each layer, save sigma2_L and tau2_L from that layer's update in the final executed cycle.
outer_train_freeze.nonconverged: If cycle 20 is reached, freeze the cycle-20 component values and emit warning.
outer_train_freeze.initial_valid_effects: After freezing the four (sigma2_L,tau2_L) pairs, run a second reference backfit on the same D_train from zero in FIXED_COMPONENT mode. These effects are the state for the first outer-VALID date.
outer_train_freeze.component_freeze_scope: The four sigma2/tau2 pairs are fixed for the entire outer-VALID fold.

outer_valid_updates.gbdt: selected Primary GBDT is fitted once on all outer-TRAIN rows and fixed through outer VALID
outer_valid_updates.before_date_d: All races on date d use the EB effect maps frozen after processing dates < d. No result from date d may affect any date-d race.
outer_valid_updates.score_formula: S_i = fhat_i_fixed_outer_train_GBDT + a_horse + a_jockey + a_horse_x_venue + a_jockey_x_venue
outer_valid_updates.date_d_residual: After all date-d races are evaluated, compute e_i=z_i-fhat_i using the same fixed outer-TRAIN GBDT raw prediction; do not subtract EB effects from this residual.
outer_valid_updates.cumulative_dataset: D_state_after_d = D_train union all outer-VALID residual rows from dates <= d
outer_valid_updates.update_algorithm: Rebuild the entire EB effect state by running reference backfit from zero on D_state_after_d in FIXED_COMPONENT mode using the outer-TRAIN frozen sigma2/tau2 pairs.
outer_valid_updates.incremental_shortcut: An optimized/cached implementation is permitted only if it is numerically equivalent to the reference full cumulative rebackfit on a deterministic audit fixture; otherwise use the reference algorithm.

inner_oof_causality_checks: max residual source date used for score on d is < d
date-d residual rows used before date-d scoring = 0
full-period inner-OOF backfit used for PL score = NO
outer_valid_checks: date-d residual used for any date-d score = 0
state residual row count is monotone nondecreasing
